basic_info.description: New Price Reduction!  6.9% CAP!  Welcome to 1230 Broadway, an exceptional investment opportunity nestled in the vibrant Russian Hill neighborhood of San Francisco, CA. This six-unit apartment building presents a rare chance to own a piece of prime real estate with immense potential. Boasting a strategic location and a host of desirable features, this property is a gem waiting to be discovered.    With four out of six units currently awaiting renovation, investors have the opportunity to unleash their creativity and maximize the value of this property. Additionally, four of the units hold the potential for conversion from one-bedroom layouts to two-bedroom residences, offering versatility and catering to a broader tenant demographic. The smart and efficient layouts of the units ensure comfortable living spaces, with spacious bedrooms that receive abundant natural sunlight, creating an inviting ambiance for tenants to enjoy.    Convenience and practicality are evident throughout the property, with three dedicated parking spaces provided onsite and the option to park additional vehicles conveniently on the street in front of the garages. Further enhancing the appeal are amenities such as a set of laundry machines and a storage room located on the ground floor.
